test_storage: Each test uses tempfile.TemporaryDirectory and a separate Backend SQLite database.
coverage: 50/5 RMB mixed cards and exact payment validation
locked, equipped and owned inventory exclusion
legacy free recharge and unfunded prebuy rejection
VIP and all implemented recharge hooks use principal only
order and packet replay, restart, conflict and account isolation
two database connections cannot spend the same final card
definite failure receipt uses pre-submit inventory and does not persist
operator mail to inventory to card payment to first reward loop
month card purchase, renewal, 30 daily rewards, expiry and clock rollback
growth fund one-time paid purchase and all activity counters
backpack 1051 compatibility and 253 unique order across reset serial
state-render and fallback-render failures preserve rollback and 1106 acknowledgement
post-commit telemetry failure cannot report a successful payment as failed
Legacy active month-card saves expose the same remaining daily quota to client and server
validation_scope: 20-test baseline plus 2 fault-injection tests and 2 legacy/month-card checks after targeted fixes; 23 unique recharge tests passed across these runs, with one month-card test repeated. Full repository suite was not completed.
